# js-vaporetto

WebAssembly bindings for [Vaporetto](https://github.com/daac-tools/vaporetto),
a fast pointwise-prediction Japanese tokenizer, usable from browsers, Node.js,
Deno and Bun.

> **This is an unofficial, community-maintained binding. It is not affiliated
> with or endorsed by daac-tools.**
>
> The name follows the naming convention of the official
> [`python-vaporetto`](https://github.com/daac-tools/python-vaporetto), but this
> project is maintained independently. Please do not report issues with
> js-vaporetto to the upstream Vaporetto repository.

Built against **Vaporetto 0.6.5** (used as a crates.io dependency; not vendored).

## Status

🚧 Work in progress. The public API is not yet complete.
